Subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff — initial redline packet & procurement checklist

Hi Stephanie / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. We're kicking off the legal + procurement work for the engagement and attaching our first-pass MSA and the Order Form Exhibit A so your contracts team has something to work from. Two things we need from Redwood to keep procurement moving:

1) A single consolidated redline (Word tracked changes) on the MSA so our GC can review line-by-line.
2) Confirmation of any non-standard hosting / residency exceptions (we're multi-region and need S0/S1 residency clarity).

Timeline: our procurement lead has requested a candidate PO by 6/24 (two weeks). If you need more time on redlines we can align on a short extension, but would prefer to avoid multiple back-and-forths.

Attachments: [Attachment: MSA_Draft_v1.docx], [Attachment: OrderForm_ExhibitA.xlsx]

Quick context on risk buckets from our side:
- Data residency: prefer US-only for now for initial scope.
- Audit rights: standard SOC2 evidence requests and a standard 30-day notice on audit scheduling.
- Term & termination: looking for a 12-month initial term.

Can you confirm who's owning redlines and procurement coordination on Redwood's side?

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Legal Ops, NovaRun

Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff — initial redline packet & procurement checklist

Thanks — I’ll take lead on the redline. High-level notes after a quick scan of MSA_Draft_v1.docx:

1) Term / Renewal: NovaRun's 12-month initial term is fine; we'll propose explicit auto-renewal language with a 30-day cancellation window.
2) Liability cap: proposes $5M. Our standard is 12 months of fees or $3M (whichever is higher). I'll propose a middle ground and flag commercial for escalation if they push.
3) Data residency / hosting: clause is vague. Jonas, can you confirm whether we can guarantee US-only tenancy for the initial contract? If not, I'll propose 'US primary with EU-optional' and specify acceptable regions.
4) Audit & evidence: Recommend providing SOC2 Type II report + up to 30 days for audit coordination. We should not accept open-ended audit rights.
5) IP & derivative works: current language is acceptable but I'll add a small carve-out clarifying customer data vs model improvements.

Planned deliverable: consolidated tracked Word redline and a one-page summary of key commercial deltas by EOD 6/18.

Questions for NovaRun (please answer inline or in reply):
- Would NovaRun accept a liability cap tied to 12 months of fees instead of a fixed $5M?
- Is US-only residency an absolute requirement for the first 12 months or can it be an aspiration with contractual controls?

Attachments I'll produce: [Attachment: Redwood_MSA_Redline_v1.docx], [Attachment: Redline_Summary_0605.pdf] (coming on 6/18)

On the procurement side, Marissa — I'll mark anything billing-related in the redline summary so you can prep the PO template.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Dir., Legal Operations — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
From: Elena Park <elena.park@novarun.com>

Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff — initial redline packet & procurement checklist

Kimberly / Stephanie — appreciate the quick responses and the clear owners. A few answers below and a note on procurement timing.

- Liability cap: NovaRun prefers a fixed $5M for this engagement due to the scope. We'll review a compromise but need a short note on why Redwood's approach (12 months fees / $3M) is preferable operationally.
- Residency: US-only for the first 12 months is our preference due to data governance. If Redwood cannot contractually guarantee physical-only hosting in a single region, please propose compensating controls (e.g., contractually enforced encryption-at-rest key management and explicit transit rules).
- Audit: SOC2 Type II within the last 12 months is required; NovaRun expects a named contact for audit scheduling.

Procurement: attaching our PO template and the internal timeline. We can flex the PO date by one week if contractual discussions surface a few open items, but our procurement lead asks that we have a clear runbook and named owners for each delta by EOD 6/18.

Attachments: [Attachment: NovaRun_PO_Template.pdf], [Attachment: Procurement_Timeline_2026-06.pdf]

We look forward to the redline on 6/18. If you foresee stricter controls (e.g., SOC2 + encryption KMS), include evidence links or your SOC attestation location in the redline summary.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Legal Ops, NovaRun
elena.park@novarun.com
